panels.title: LLM daily spend vs cap
panels.description: Today's LLM spend against the configured daily cap (cap = 0 when none configured). The cap hard-stops LLM calls at 100%; SpendOver80PctCap warns first.

panels.title: Ack latency (avg seconds)
panels.description: Average seconds from case open to acknowledgment. §14 target: human touch per case well under 10 min — this is the acknowledgment leg of that.

panels.title: Cases opened today
panels.description: Shortage cases opened today — the throughput denominator behind the §14 process metrics.

panels.title: Critical unacked count (under-escalation signal)
panels.description: §14 target: under-escalation ≈ 0. A non-zero count of critical cases sitting unacknowledged is the closest live proxy — pairs with the CriticalCaseUnacked alert.

options.content:
### §14 success metrics (business-process-tied)

These are the SLO targets the panels above track against. Some are computed offline (eval CI, shadow agreement) and are **not** live Prometheus series yet — the closest live signals are noted.

| §14 target | Live signal on this dashboard |
| --- | --- |
| Time-to-approved-protocol: days → **< 1 hr** machine + review latency | **Ack latency (avg seconds)** — acknowledgment leg; p95 time-to-protocol is computed offline (may read 0 here). |
| Human touch per case: hours → **< 10 min** | **Ack latency (avg seconds)** |
| Draft acceptance **≥ 80%** unedited (agreement %) | Computed offline from review outcomes (not a live gauge yet). |
| **Under-escalation ≈ 0** | **Critical unacked count** + the `CriticalCaseUnacked` alert. |
| **0 dropped cases** (every shortage reaches terminal state) | **Cases opened today** vs terminal-state counts; dropped-case detection is offline. |

A panel reading 0 here means "no signal yet today," not "target missed" — cross-check the offline eval/KPI report for the metrics marked computed-offline.
